title: The Snowy morning in January
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：snowy　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 snowy 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the musician wrote of ① a snowy morning in January in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② snowier than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the snowy ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the snowiest morning in January anybody in the hall had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too snowy to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the snowy ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a snowy road over the pass, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as snowy as the road over the pass they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was snowy or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something snowy, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite snowy; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the snowy ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, without complaint, she wrote of another snowy morning in January in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ snowier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The snowiest road over the pass in the whole hall, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the snowy ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 多雪（前置定语 a snowy morning in January：1976 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件多雪的清晨）
B. adj. 多雪／积雪（比较级 snowier than：文中两处，一处比一月里落雪的清晨，一处比预想）
C. adj. 多雪／积雪（最高级 the snowiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 多雪（表语 too snowy to do：母亲觉得它太多雪，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 积雪（前置定语 a snowy road over the pass：叔叔把整件事称作一桩积雪的路）
F. adj. 积雪（同级比较 as snowy as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩山口积雪的路相比）
G. adj. 积雪（后置定语 something snowy：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 积雪（受程度副词修饰 quite snowy：那位听客的评价）

items.q: the snowiest morning in January anybody
a snowy road over the pass
The snowiest road over the pass in

answers.why: snowy 意为“多雪”，1976 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件多雪的清晨”，此处作前置定语 a snowy morning in January。
snowy 意为“多雪”，此处用比较级 snowier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
snowy 意为“多雪”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说它是音乐厅里最多雪的一件，故用最高级 the snowiest morning in January。
snowy 意为“多雪”，母亲认为这件东西“太多雪了，谁也用不上”，too snowy to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
snowy 意为“积雪”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩积雪的路”，此处作前置定语 a snowy road over the pass。
snowy 意为“积雪”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩山口积雪的路一样积雪”，同级比较用 as snowy as。
snowy 意为“积雪”，节目单上那半行字要的是“积雪的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something snowy。
snowy 意为“积雪”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当积雪”，quite 修饰原级 snowy。
snowy 意为“积雪”，1986 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要积雪”，故用比较级 snowier than。
snowy 意为“积雪”，母亲 1988 年说的是“整个音乐厅里最积雪的那一桩”，故用最高级 the snowiest road over the pass。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件多雪的清晨。（a snowy morning in January）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更多雪。（snowier than …）
母亲觉得它太多雪，谁也用不上。（too snowy to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩积雪的路。（a snowy road over the pass）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩山口积雪的路一样积雪。（as snowy as …）
到了 1983 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件积雪的东西。（something snowy）
answers: In 1976 the musician wrote of a snowy morning in January in the programme.
Everybody said it was snowier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too snowy to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a snowy road over the pass.
He said nobody would call it as snowy as the road over the pass they had once had.
By 1983 the programme asked for nothing but something snowy.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 snowy 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the musician wrote of a snowy morning in January in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the snowiest morning in January in the hall, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too snowy to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a snowy road over the pass, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite snowy, and everybody laughed.
The snowy ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
